title: Flow Language Vertical Slice
description: End-to-end vertical slice for flow procedural language: neural engine (Dictionary/Neuron/Evaluator), math module, DAG UI crate, flow core wasm, react renderer, and play app with slider->add->preview default fixture.
summary: Moved flow inputs onto the canvas: slider track/thumb and value painted on InputSlider nodes, note text on InputNote, preview value on OutputPreview; pointer drag on slider nodes adjusts value in flow/core. Removed HTML overlay controls from FlowCanvas. Fixed wasm viewport (setSize before attach, preserve viewport on loadFixtureJson) so screen hit-testing works before GPU attach. Updated validate-flow-runtime.mjs for canvas slider drag at layout position.
